<!-- pr-reviewer: 15b4344a8f29a52532f9ba8b25da6d1180be73b6 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. I reviewed the code against upstream main's current AGENTS.md.
The local trial merge with upstream/main `370d38df63bbb7fcacc142f524fcf64c095b5ed2` was clean.

The stock reaches the rotary generator through the existing command path. The clip separates cut runs before the radial links are built.
The ramp guard keeps the ramp start inside the held-end window. The tests also retain the free-end and facing-allowance cases.

Local results:

- The selected motion test targets built successfully.
- `camcraft-motion --lib rotary_ends`: 3 passed.
- `camcraft-motion --test rotary`: 11 passed.
- `camcraft-motion --test rotary_links`: 7 passed.
- `camcraft-app --test continuous_4axis_part`: 10 passed. These include main's shared comparison tests.
- `camcraft-app --test center_cut_multiaxis`: 6 passed.
- `camcraft-app --test rotary_verify`: 9 passed.
- `python3 site/tests/test_first_continuous_4axis_part.py`: 14 passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

I repeated two mutations with `the_parallel_leaves_the_end_face_where_the_stock_goes_on`:

- With the clip result discarded, the test failed: `the ball center passed the held end's plane: station -1.0139999625247755`.
- With the ramp guard disabled, the test failed: `a ramp runs in from past the plane`. The ramp started at station -8.032608591466476.

The test passed after each restoration. No mutation remains in the code.

I checked every changed NC line. The removed end-face cuts become retracts, clearance indexing and plunges at the held end.
The other changes concern modal feed words and small rounding differences. The free-end cut remains.
The project JSON changes its cached moves, adds the held-end note, and updates version 70 to 71.
Every non-rapid cached move stays at or inside X-31.75 mm. The project and NC comparison tests pass after the trial merge.

No `crates/ui` file changes, so the UI screenshot requirement does not apply.
No dependency, build script, workflow or process file changes.

Requested changes: none.

Limits: I did not run the program on a machine or in PathPilot. I did not add coverage for tilted axes or domed held ends.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

This PR does not merge with `main` now (GitHub reports `CONFLICTING` at head `15b4344a8`). I added the `conflicts` label. I did not remove `merge-ready`.

Please merge `main` into the branch (no rebase, no force-push) and comment "ready for a re-check". If the merge is clean, the review of this head stays valid.

Left out of today's merge batch: it now conflicts with main in `examples/first-continuous-4axis-part.camproj` (main moved that example to project v72 in #2563; this PR also changes it). The refresh must regenerate the example with `WRITE_GOLDEN=1` on top of main and explain every changed line of its `.nc` golden; then a delta review. Labelled `conflicts`.

Ready for a re-check. The new head is `82dd1d1b0e140ff7c8cb9ab3d81e928b03417d9b`.

I merged `main` (`75e74a9cb`) into the branch with a merge commit. I did not rebase and I did not force-push.

**Finding: the PR conflicts with `main` in `examples/first-continuous-4axis-part.camproj`.**

- The merge had one conflict, in that file. All other files merged automatically.
- I regenerated the example with `WRITE_GOLDEN=1 cargo test -p camcraft-app --test continuous_4axis_part` on the merged tree.
- The regenerated project is the reviewed file of `15b4344a8` with one changed line: `"version": 71` is now `"version": 72`. The cached moves and the held-end note are the same.
- `git show --remerge-diff 82dd1d1b0` shows only the removal of the conflict markers in that file.

**The `.nc` golden.**

- `examples/first-continuous-4axis-part.nc` has no changed line against the reviewed head `15b4344a8`. Thus the line check of the first review applies to each line of its diff against `main`.
- `main` did not change this file after the merge base `1ae4d061f`.
- The regeneration on this machine (macOS) gave 15 different lines. I did not commit them. These are the lines:
  - 13 `G0` clearance index lines, where the A word moves by 0.001 degree (for example `A43.171` and `A43.172`).
  - 1 `G1` line, `A46.549` and `A46.548`, with its F word `F232.558` and `F232.408`.
  - The subsequent `G1` line, where the F word changes from `F232.408` to `F232.558`.
- No X, Y or Z word differs. `wrapped_nc::compare` permits one A rounding step and its rate-limited feed, and the committed program passes it.
- My reading: this is a last-digit difference between build machines, not an effect of the merge. The project file gives the same cached moves, and `main` changed no code of the rotary generator or of the A word format. I did not build the pre-merge head on this machine to prove this.

**Pins.**

- `the_committed_project_uses_the_current_file_version` (from `main`) pins the version. Mutation: with `"version": 71` it fails (`regenerate examples/first-continuous-4axis-part.camproj`), and `the_continuous_4axis_part_posts_its_wrapped_program` fails with `/version: 72 != 71`. With the version restored, the two tests pass.
- `the_committed_project_posts_the_committed_program` passes: the merged project posts the committed program.
- `the_pass_leaves_the_chuck_side_end_face` and `a_short_flute_posts_now_that_the_chuck_side_end_face_is_left` pass on the merged code.

**Gate.**

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 132 steps, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

I made the PR a draft before the push, because this refresh has a hand-resolved conflict (class DELTA). Please do a delta review of the new head.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 82dd1d1b0e140ff7c8cb9ab3d81e928b03417d9b -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review of the refreshed head. I used the current laws from `upstream/main:AGENTS.md`.
The local trial merge with upstream/main `4a326c7d978b36f24e22cc47395a34a3100c7a22` was clean.

The earlier conflict finding is resolved. The merge uses a merge commit, without a rebase.
Its remerge diff removes only the conflict markers around the project version.
The project differs from the previously reviewed head `15b4344a8` only in its version: 71 becomes 72.
The cached moves and the held-end note are unchanged. The NC file is identical to that reviewed head.
The author's later comment gives the regeneration results and explains the rounding differences.

Local results on the trial merge:

- The selected motion and app test targets built successfully.
- `camcraft-motion --lib rotary_ends`: 3 passed.
- `camcraft-motion --test rotary`: 11 passed.
- `camcraft-motion --test rotary_links`: 7 passed.
- `camcraft-app --test continuous_4axis_part`: 10 passed.
- `camcraft-app --test center_cut_multiaxis`: 6 passed.
- `camcraft-app --test rotary_verify`: 9 passed.
- `python3 site/tests/test_first_continuous_4axis_part.py`: 14 passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

I repeated two mutations with `the_parallel_leaves_the_end_face_where_the_stock_goes_on`:

- Discard the clip result: failed with `the ball center passed the held end's plane: station -1.0139999625247755`.
- Disable the ramp guard: failed with `a ramp runs in from past the plane`. The ramp started at station -8.032608591466476.

The test passed after each restoration. Neither mutation remains.

I checked each changed NC row against current main, including the modal positions of the removed A-only moves.
The removed end-face feeds become retracts, clearance indexing and plunges at the held end.
All 1210 new rapid rows at that end have Z at least 0.874 in; the stock radius is 0.375 in.
The 42 new feed rows there stay inside X-1.25 and at Z0.339 or higher.
The other changes move G93/G94 words or change the last A digit and its rate-limited feed.
The free-end minimum Z stays -0.0322 in. The project and NC comparison tests pass.
All non-rapid cached moves stay inside the held-end plane at X-31.75 mm.

No `crates/ui` files change, so the UI screenshot requirement does not apply.
No dependency, build script, workflow or process files change.

The first build stalled with the optional cache enabled. I stopped it and completed the checks with `RUSTC_WRAPPER=`.
The gate planner ran in dry-run mode only; I ran the relevant suites listed above directly.
No GitHub runner was used. I did not run the program on a machine or in PathPilot.
Tilted axes and domed held ends remain outside the exercised cases.

Requested changes: none.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Merge class: SAME. The reviewed head is the merged head, `82dd1d1b0e140ff7c8cb9ab3d81e928b03417d9b`. No commit came after it.

The refresh of 06:45 UTC merged `main` and resolved a conflict by hand. The safety-tier review by mkinney's review agent of 07:10 UTC is a review of that refreshed head. The PR fixes a P3 (#2343) and touches no P1, so no second review is necessary.
